retention.stated: No retention statement documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
retention.notes: Dormant project deletion is disabled on GitLab.com. No expiry period for container images is stated on the pages read.

egress.terms: unverified: no egress charge or volume quota is stated on the pages read. Anonymous pulls: a public project whose container registry visibility is set to Everyone With Access lets anonymous users view the registry and pull images.

tooling: ORAS / docker / skopeo / crane all work against registry.gitlab.com; rclone has no OCI backend but 'oras cp' + rclone covers push/pull. Public projects allow anonymous pull tokens.
chaining: The container registry is not included in the project storage limit, which covers the project's repository and LFS (10 GiB for a Free tier namespace project). A per-layer cap of 5 GB, and the number of projects or accounts allowed: unverified, not stated on the pages read.

The container registry, package registry, and build artifacts are not included in the limit.' The 10 GiB Free limit therefore does not apply to OCI blobs.
extras.limits_verbatim: Container registry storage is visible but not capped in docs; individual blob uploads go through the standard Docker chunked path so layer size is bounded by the client, not by a documented per-file cap. Requires CI or a token for push; anonymous pull works on public projects.
extras.egress_verbatim: No egress charge is published for gitlab.com registry pulls; anonymous pulls are served without auth beyond a JWT. Effectively unmetered for anonymous public projects.
extras.chaining_verbatim: Unlimited projects per namespace x unlimited namespaces/accounts x 5 GB per layer (generic package max file is 5 GB; container layers see the same class of limit). Since blobs are outside the 10 GiB project quota, a single free account can host arbitrarily many OCI layers. Compare GHCR (already known) — the differentiator here is the explicit quota exemption, not the registry itself.
extras.tooling_verbatim: ORAS / docker / skopeo / crane all work against registry.gitlab.com; rclone has no OCI backend but 'oras cp' + rclone covers push/pull. Public projects allow anonymous pull tokens.
